implementation_notes: A context is a namespace plus a target/library. Use separate static libraries (or modules) per context so the linker enforces the cut; expose one façade header per context and keep the rest in the .cpp.
idiom_name: separate static library per context + one façade header
pitfalls: A common header library that both contexts include, collapsing the boundary
Templates in the shared header forcing cross-context recompilation
